labels: Only original public labels are included. No labels generated from TIFFs.

datasets.name: Condensin_3D_time_IDR5514375
datasets.evidence: Native NGFF and IDR pixels; IDR experiment description states 90 seconds. Normalized legacy label axes units to unit; original metadata retained under sources/.
datasets.selection: All 40 frames, 3 channels, and both original Cell/Chromosomes label layers.

datasets.name: Lung_tilescan_IDR9798462
datasets.evidence: Publication: Tissue samples and image acquisition, Aperio AT2 at 0.253 micrometers/pixel. Added missing calibration to the prepared copy.
datasets.selection: Full 21,115 x 16,433 RGB image and all 8 source pyramid levels.

datasets.name: Melanoma_2D_time_IDR12922361
datasets.calibration: XY: 0.325 micrometers/pixel. Acquisition interval not verified; temporal axis remains frame index.
datasets.evidence: IDR REST Pixels PhysicalSizeX/Y values. Publication and annotation sources checked; no reliable matching acquisition interval recovered.
datasets.selection: First 60 consecutive frames of the 721-frame source, full 2560 x 2160 native pixels, all 6 pyramid levels.

datasets.name: Neurites_fluorescence_DRG
datasets.category: Fluorescent neural outgrowth with original masks
datasets.evidence: Dataset readme and publication Data Records section specify 2.58 micrometers/pixel.
datasets.selection: Original image 01_0101u_0p0_001p000.tif, original explant and neurite binary masks. No segmentation generated.

datasets.name: Neurites_phase_NeuroQuantify
datasets.evidence: Publication states 1 micrometer = 2.21 pixels. TIFF Snap-573 from test set B; preserve all three source RGB planes.
datasets.selection: Original Snap-573.tif, 2560 x 1920; new downsampled pyramid; no generated labels.

datasets.name: Tonsil_27channels_IDR5025553
datasets.calibration: Spatial calibration unverified; pixel units only.
datasets.evidence: Native NGFF and IDR Pixels omit physical sizes. Publication confirms Hyperion imaging mass cytometry but does not specify a matching pixel pitch; no instrument-default calibration assumed.
datasets.selection: Full 2500 x 2500 image, all 27 original named channels and 5 pyramid levels.

datasets.name: Zebrafish_lightsheet_IDR4007817
datasets.calibration: Spatial calibration unverified; pixel units only. Time interval 120 seconds according to the IDR experiment description.
datasets.evidence: IDR study describes this dataset as one frame per 2 minutes. Publication describes a 2.5-minute imaging protocol; discrepancy is retained here. Preview downsampling factor and physical pixel size are not verified, so no micrometer pitch assigned.
datasets.selection: All 79 source preview volumes, 333 x 333 x 201, all 3 pyramid levels; no generated labels.
